main_text.head: I. Sequitur Obsignatio, de qua 2 Cor. I, 22. Qui (Deus) etiam obsignavit nos. Eph. I, 13, IV, 30.
main_text.p: Est autem actus gratiosus moralis, quo certis quibusdam pignoribus & sigillis, in nobis confirmatur subjectiva certitudo mysticę communionis

page.notes: Large woodcut initial S at the start of the paragraph beginning "Sequitur". The head "I." is a numbered paragraph marker; the first lines of the division are set beside the initial. Some words in the printed text are uncertain (e.g. "subjectiva" rendered as printed "fubleĉtiva"); the final word "nis" is a catchword-like continuation printed at the foot of the column.
